title: Validate versioned approval arguments
prompt: Validate an immutable proposal approval. Proposal has id,version,arguments; approval has id,version,argument_hash,decision. Canonicalize arguments to SHA256, and return whether approved ID/version/hash all match plus current hash. Persistence and effect dispatch are external; argument changes invalidate approval.
